subject: how to get a download URL

messages.author: e3bbf74d77438223
messages.subject: how to get a download URL
parts:
I am using  Javascript along with Shiny. I have an input button created  in javascript client-side to send the client data to the server. At the server side this input is processed to generate a pdf of the data using 'Observe' function.
Now I want the download url to be sent to the client of that pdf by using 'session$sendCustomMessage'. I don't want to use shiny 'downloadbutton' or 'downloadlink'.
Is there any solution that the downloadHandler could return just the download url of the the output file.

Thanks in advance for any help.
